original.system: Answer the multiple-choice reading comprehension question using the passage. Reply with exactly one option letter and nothing else.

short_system.system: Reply with A, B, C, or D.

no_template.system: Answer the multiple-choice reading comprehension question using the passage. Reply with exactly one option letter and nothing else.

no_template_literal.system: Answer the multiple-choice reading comprehension question using the passage. Reply with exactly one option letter and nothing else.

primary_output_tokens: bare A/B/C/D; one token; no thinking or generation loop
secondary_output_grammar: Also score bare or single-leading-space letter tokens from the same hidden state; aggregate aliases by probability sum.
diagnostic_sample: First 10 frozen cases, each variant, full context; full-vocabulary diagnostics outside timed region.
latency: One decision per method and condition per case; randomized interleaving. No prefix or whole-state reuse. CLM actions cached.
